name: Ecology, Evolution and Organismal Biology PhD

english.toefl: 90 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 on or after January 21, 2026
english.note: IELTS 7 is a recommended minimum. Programs may require higher scores. English-medium degrees may exempt testing; applicants outside the listed countries should arrange a Registrar/Dean letter confirming English instruction.

applicationFee.note: Documented financial hardship: request through the application with an explanation and accepted financial-aid/FAFSA/CSS/unemployment/test-fee-reduction documentation. Recommended at least two weeks before deadline. International applicants should confirm documentation eligibility.

documents: College transcripts with certified English translations where needed
Five program questions in place of a personal statement (250–500 words each)
Graduate School community/inclusion question (330 words maximum)
requirements.note: At least two recommendations should be from faculty at the current or most recently attended institution. Recommenders submit online; Interfolio not accepted. Official final transcripts required before matriculation. Typical preparation: ecology, evolution, organismal/comparative biology, cell/molecular biology and biostatistics. No rigid prerequisites; deficiencies may be remedied after entry. Contact potential faculty before applying; identify one or more faculty in the essays.

funding.note: Central doctoral support applies to domestic and foreign students, conditional on satisfactory academic progress; transfer-student funding may vary.
